name: Akita SaaS Directory

sources.title: Akita Integrations Directory — SaaS apps that integrate with Akita

conditions: This is Akita's *integrations* directory — to be listed your product must actually integrate with the Akita customer-success platform (100+ SaaS integrations)
Route is a request by email, not a form: 'Email your integration request to hello@akitaapp.com'
requirements: A SaaS product in one of their integration categories (CRM, support, surveys, billing, analytics, etc.)
A working or planned technical integration with Akita (they expose an API/docs at docs.akitaapp.com and akitaapp.com/api)
B2B fit — categories are all business software
preparation: Product name, URL, category fit against their 19 integration categories
Integration feasibility: review Akita's API docs before requesting
An email to hello@akitaapp.com proposing the integration (or support@akitaapp.com for the 'can't find app' route)
workflow: Confirm your product fits an existing category in /directory
Work with Akita on the actual integration
Once integrated, your product appears in the integrations directory
watchFor: Not a launch directory — a listing without a real integration is unlikely
This is a partnership/integration request, not a marketing submission; expect a product/engineering conversation
Stale catalog note: the directory lists long-dead products (Desk.com, Basecamp Classic) suggesting slow curation
No pricing is discussed — but the real 'cost' is building and maintaining the integration
countsAsLive: Your product's name/logo appears in the Akita integrations directory under a category
unknowns: Whether Akita accepts listings for planned (not yet built) integrations
Whether there is a formal partner program vs ad-hoc email
Whether Akita (the CS platform) is still actively maintained — directory looks dated
